package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type menuFailWriter struct{ err error }

func (w menuFailWriter) Write([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, w.err }

func fixtureMenu() Menu {
	return Menu{
		Label: "Synthetic account menu",
		Links: []MenuLink{
			{Label: "View profile", URL: "/fixture/profile"},
			{Label: "Help", URL: "https://example.test/help"},
		},
		Submit: &MenuSubmit{
			Label: "Sign out", Action: "/fixture/sign-out",
			CSRFName: "csrf_token", CSRFToken: "synthetic-token", Disabled: false,
		},
	}
}

func menuConstructors() []func(Menu) (interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}, error) {
	return []func(Menu) (interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}, error){
		func(data Menu) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewMenu(data)
		},
		func(data Menu) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewMenuEnhanced(data)
		},
	}
}

func requireMenuError(t *testing.T, data Menu) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, constructor := range menuConstructors() {
		if component, err := constructor(data); err == nil || component != nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid menu accepted")
		}
	}
}

func renderMenu(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out.String()
}

func TestMenuConstructorsEscapeAndSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	for _, constructor := range menuConstructors() {
		data := fixtureMenu()
		data.Label = `<script>unsafe()</script> & menu`
		data.Links[0].Label = `<img src=x> profile`
		data.Submit.Label = `<b>sign out</b>`
		component, err := constructor(data)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		data.Label = "mutated menu"
		data.Links[0] = MenuLink{Label: "mutated link", URL: "/mutated"}
		data.Links = append(data.Links, MenuLink{Label: "extra", URL: "/extra"})
		data.Submit.Label, data.Submit.Action, data.Submit.CSRFToken = "mutated submit", "/mutated", "mutated-token"
		markup := renderMenu(t, component)
		for _, absent := range []string{"<script>", "<img src=x>", "<b>", "mutated menu", "mutated link", "/mutated", "mutated-token", "/extra"} {
			if strings.Contains(markup, absent) {
				t.Fatalf("render observed markup or caller mutation %q", absent)
			}
		}
		for _, present := range []string{"&lt;script&gt;unsafe()&lt;/script&gt;", "&lt;img src=x&gt;", "&lt;b&gt;sign out&lt;/b&gt;", "/fixture/profile", "https://example.test/help", "/fixture/sign-out", "csrf_token", "synthetic-token"} {
			if !strings.Contains(markup, present) {
				t.Fatalf("render omitted binding %q", present)
			}
		}
		lowerMarkup := strings.ToLower(markup)
		if !strings.Contains(lowerMarkup, `method="post"`) || strings.Contains(lowerMarkup, `target=`) {
			t.Fatal("submit did not retain fixed POST/no-target contract")
		}
	}
}

func TestMenuLinkAndSubmitShapes(t *testing.T) {
	linksOnly := fixtureMenu()
	linksOnly.Submit = nil
	if _, err := NewMenu(linksOnly); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	exactLinks := fixtureMenu()
	exactLinks.Submit = nil
	exactLinks.Links = make([]MenuLink, 12)
	for i := range exactLinks.Links {
		exactLinks.Links[i] = MenuLink{Label: "item", URL: "/item"}
	}
	if _, err := NewMenuEnhanced(exactLinks); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	submitOnly := fixtureMenu()
	submitOnly.Links = nil
	submitOnly.Submit.Disabled = true
	component, err := NewMenu(submitOnly)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if markup := renderMenu(t, component); !strings.Contains(markup, "disabled") || !strings.Contains(markup, "synthetic-token") {
		t.Fatal("disabled submit missing or skipped validated CSRF binding")
	}
	empty := fixtureMenu()
	empty.Links, empty.Submit = nil, nil
	requireMenuError(t, empty)
	tooMany := fixtureMenu()
	tooMany.Links = make([]MenuLink, 13)
	for i := range tooMany.Links {
		tooMany.Links[i] = MenuLink{Label: "item", URL: "/item"}
	}
	requireMenuError(t, tooMany)
}

func TestMenuRejectsInvalidTextAndCSRF(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Menu){
		func(data *Menu) { data.Label = "" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Label = strings.Repeat("x", 161) },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Label = "bad\nlabel" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Label = string([]byte{0xff}) },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Links[0].Label = " " },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.Label = "bad\tlabel" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFName = "" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFName = "1token" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFName = "bad.name" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFName = strings.Repeat("x", 65) },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFToken = "" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFToken = "bad\ntoken" },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFToken = string([]byte{0xff}) },
		func(data *Menu) { data.Submit.CSRFToken = strings.Repeat("x", 4097) },
	} {
		data := fixtureMenu()
		mutate(&data)
		requireMenuError(t, data)
	}
	for _, hazard := range []string{"acceptCharset", "action", "autocomplete", "checkValidity", "elements", "encoding", "enctype", "id", "length", "METHOD", "name", "noValidate", "rel", "relList", "reportValidity", "requestSubmit", "reset", "submit", "target"} {
		data := fixtureMenu()
		data.Submit.CSRFName = hazard
		requireMenuError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestMenuRejectsInvalidDestinations(t *testing.T) {
	badLinks := []string{"", "relative", "#fragment", "//example.test/x", `/bad\\path`, "/%2fexample.test", "/bad%5cpath", "/bad%0apath", "https://user@example.test/x", "https:opaque", "https://example.test:0/x", "https://example.test:65536/x", "http://example.test/x", "javascript:alert(1)", "data:text/plain,x", "%zz", string([]byte{0xff}), "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048)}
	for _, bad := range badLinks {
		data := fixtureMenu()
		data.Links[0].URL = bad
		requireMenuError(t, data)
	}
	badActions := []string{"", "relative", "//example.test/x", "/action?", "/action?next=x", "/action#", "/action#fragment", `/bad\\path`, "/%2fexample.test", "/bad%0apath", "https://example.test/action", "%zz", string([]byte{0xff}), "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048)}
	for _, bad := range badActions {
		data := fixtureMenu()
		data.Submit.Action = bad
		requireMenuError(t, data)
	}
	encodedPath := fixtureMenu()
	encodedPath.Submit.Action = "/action%23part"
	if _, err := NewMenu(encodedPath); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("encoded path character rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMenuExactBoundsAndDisabledTokenValidation(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureMenu()
	data.Label = strings.Repeat("m", 160)
	data.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("l", 256)
	data.Links[0].URL = "/" + strings.Repeat("u", 2047)
	data.Submit.Label = strings.Repeat("s", 256)
	data.Submit.Action = "/" + strings.Repeat("a", 2047)
	data.Submit.CSRFName = "_" + strings.Repeat("n", 63)
	data.Submit.CSRFToken = strings.Repeat("t", 4096)
	data.Submit.Disabled = true
	for _, constructor := range menuConstructors() {
		if component, err := constructor(data); err != nil || component == nil {
			t.Fatalf("exact bounds rejected: %v", err)
		}
	}
	data.Submit.CSRFToken = ""
	requireMenuError(t, data)
}

func TestMenuCancellationAndWriterFailure(t *testing.T) {
	for _, constructor := range menuConstructors() {
		component, err := constructor(fixtureMenu())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancel()
		var out bytes.Buffer
		if err := component.Render(ctx, &out); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || out.Len() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("pre-cancelled render: err=%v bytes=%d", err, out.Len())
		}
		sentinel := errors.New("writer failure")
		if err := component.Render(context.Background(), menuFailWriter{sentinel}); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
			t.Fatal("writer error lost")
		}
	}
}

func TestMenuValidationErrorsDoNotExposeValues(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureMenu()
	secret := "secret-invalid-value"
	data.Links[0].URL = secret
	component, err := NewMenu(data)
	if err == nil || component != nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), secret) {
		t.Fatal("invalid destination accepted or exposed")
	}
}
